exact_missing_items: Multi-Account.md still has no durable account.switched / switch-episode family
provider_accounts.run_snapshot still stores only an opaque policy_hash rather than a queryable policy version/ref
no canonical role enum or actor_kind / execution_role field exists to support role-by-provider and role-by-account overrides consistently across docs
On restart, the runtime restores current unresolved blocked episodes from canonical blocked/runtime records/projections
The scheduler then emits a scheduler pass with wake_reason = startup_recovered; that startup-recovery pass does not mint new blocked episodes by itself; it rehydrates existing unresolved episodes
Executor_Protocol.md names startup_recovered but does not define the restore handshake strongly enough to prevent silent block-loss or accidental episode reminting
Define startup-recovery handshake ownership in Executor_Protocol.md + Contracts_V0.md
OperationalIdentity block is missing from runtime snapshots in storage-plan.md and Contracts_V0.md
OperationalIdentity must carry: effective_account_id, effective_runtime_id, effective_persona_key, execution_role, actor_kind, requested_account_binding, any_pressure_flags, any_degradation_flags
This block is the single source of effective-identity truth for auditing, receipts, and downstream projections

Orchestrator Progress widget layout decision: app-default with project override — this must be the single authoritative decision documented in Widget_System.md and cross-referenced from Orchestrator_Page.md
do-not-forget: run.started MUST field list in storage-plan.md still disagrees with the surrounding prose about how much identity to include
do-not-forget: provider_accounts.run_snapshot policy_hash should be a policy_version_ref for downstream policy-validity queries
Projection closure for concern records: every concern must be queryable by source surface (Orchestrator, Run Graph, Usage, History), by owner, by severity, and by resolution status
The canonical concern record family must be present in storage-plan.md; currently entirely absent
concern_id must be stable and usable as a route payload object_id for deep-link targeting
Projection-freshness trust vocabulary must be distinct from Preview trust_tier — trust_tier is already occupied in that namespace
Projection trust vocabulary must use a different name such as projection_freshness, data_freshness, or staleness_state
Using trust_tier for both preview capability trust and projection freshness would create a naming collision across surfaces
Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md still lacks attempt-level identity, producer attribution, trustworthy cost_usage linkage, and degraded/stale projector behavior
attempt_id is still absent from the canonical artifact ID set even though receipt linkage and the run-graph model now rely on attempt-level identity
runtime-artifact payload ownership is still split across docs without an actually-populated canonical schema family
The attention center cluster requires a canonical record family for project_attention_item

Minimum projection shape: attention_item_id, project_id, severity, owner_kind, reason_code, source_kind, source_object_ref, primary_route_payload, secondary_route_payloads[], display_title, display_subtitle, disclosure_visibility
This record family is absent from storage-plan.md and from Contracts_V0.md
The canonical minimum field set is: `target_kind`; `project_id`; one canonical target selector (`subject_id` OR `object_kind` + `object_id`)
The narrow scope-restoration fields are: `focused_run_id`; `thread_id`
The narrow focus-refinement fields are: `tab_id`; `inspector_target`
Full bounded shape: `target_kind`, `project_id`, `focused_run_id`, `thread_id`, `tab_id`, `subject_id`, `object_kind`, `object_id`, `inspector_target`
`project_id` is required. Exactly one canonical target selector is required.

What is NOT a base `route_target` field: `usage_event_ref`, `wizard_id`, `wizard_step`, `message_id`, `artifact_id`, `document_id`, `workflow_run_id`, `scheduler_pass_id`, `safe_point_id`, `remediation_root_id`, `line`, `range`, per-surface state (`active_subview`, compare target, panel layout, browser tab state, widget layout)
The canonical selector rule is: exactly one primary selector is present: `subject_id` OR `object_kind` + `object_id`
`subject_id` wins for openable/renderable content subjects.
`object_kind` + `object_id` wins for domain/runtime/governance objects.
`tab_id`, `focused_run_id`, `thread_id`, and `inspector_target` never replace primary selector identity.
`project_id` is required scope, not selector identity.

Resolution order: (1) restore project_id, (2) restore route scope (focused_run_id, thread_id), (3) restore destination class from target_kind, (4) resolve primary selector (subject_id OR object_kind+object_id), (5) apply narrow focus refinement (tab_id, inspector_target)
Reject multi-selector route payloads as non-canonical. Normalize all special-case ids into `subject_id` or `object_kind` + `object_id` before they enter the canonical route layer.
stale_tokens: task_id (in artifact docs, where rewrite needs node_id/package/seam/lane identity)
canonical_replacement_hints: object_kind + object_id for wizard_id, message_id, usage_event, scheduler_pass_id, safe_point_id, remediation_root_id
object_kind + object_id for all listed special-case IDs
